address: 3, Alley 39, Cunzhong Street, West District, Taichung, Taiwan
bio: This restaurant is spread over two floors, complete with a vaulted ceiling and a courtyard. Bare concrete and brick walls contrast well with the wood-rich interior. You can expect a single tasting menu, with a varying number of courses at lunch and dinner. The exact items change with the season, but they all celebrate Taiwan’s produce and culinary culture with layered textures, thoughtful compositions, and creative techniques. The cold-brewed tea pairings are also worth exploring, making a distinctive and well-matched accompaniment to the menu.
